checks: The desktop menu and match expose gear buttons, with one language selector inside settings
Fresh preferences retain the current physical style and both original shadow effects
Both real gear handlers open the shared native settings dialog and closing restores the originating button’s focus
Native Back/Escape cancellation closes settings without starting a game
Keyboard focus wraps inside settings
Fullscreen promotion re-raises settings and a queued close event does not dismiss the reopened dialog
Actual setting controls independently apply classic motion, fixed shadows and lighter glow
All three choices survive a new preference load
Invalid stored values cannot enable unintended modes
Malformed saved JSON safely uses the original visual defaults
Blocked browser storage still allows immediate setting changes
Every settings label has an English and Chinese presentation
The same settings controls remain available when native dialogs are unavailable
Two hundred tabletop move samples use cached size and bounds with zero repeated geometry reads
A moving chapter-introduction card also reuses both card dimensions and the introduction area
A real resize observer invalidates geometry and the next move measures each affected box once
The updated geometry is reused immediately after invalidation
Scrolling, visual viewport changes and fullscreen changes all invalidate cached geometry
Classic tabletop motion follows the grip without automatic rotation or a release throw
Switching back restores the real physical release throw
Opening settings retires active tabletop momentum before changing its mode
Two hundred forty hand pointer events collapse into exactly one live drop-target test on the next frame
A stationary pointer does not repeat drop-target testing on later animation frames
Releasing before the next frame still checks the final live target and commits the newly reached tile
Release and landing share one target-size snapshot instead of measuring again after DOM writes
A release outside the board cannot reuse a previously highlighted valid tile
An invalid release returns to the full cached card size even while the source has its smaller dragging transform
The same coalesced handler preserves shop drop routing
Cancelling a touch releases the gesture, animations and target without committing a card
Opening settings cancels a held hand card and clears its pending animation and drag-only choice
Classic hand dragging directly follows the latest grip with no spring delay or automatic tilt
The physical hand mode retains spring following and visible rotation
Fixed shadow stops the velocity-dependent offset while retaining the original blur and glow
The second toggle independently reduces shadow blur and glow
Unchanged shadow values are reused across a hundred twenty paints without redundant style writes
Fifteen-, twenty- and thirty-frame updates advance the same full elapsed physical time as sixty-frame updates
A stale frame after a long pause reconnects to the current finger instead of replaying old momentum
Reduced-motion preference still overrides automatic spring and tilt
scope: Actual native/fallback settings and preference handlers, bilingual labels, gesture/frame handlers, geometry cache invalidation, current/classic motion, fresh release targets, cancellation, shop routing, shadow switches and low-frame-rate time integration. Controlled DOM geometry and compositor ordering; physical-phone FPS and GPU paint cost are not measured.
